title: Meeting Louis at Smalls and the lip salve
summary: Louis came to hear him at Smalls and called him Little Jazz; Roy's use of Louis's salve ruined his lips for a week.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Then I went with Teddy Hill. Smalls is where I really... That's when I first met Louis, is when I was at Smalls.
Oh yeah? Did he come over...?
Yeah, he used to come down to hear me. He told me, "Little Jazz, you're going to be all right." Now, he gave me some salve, that salve he used to put on his
lips. I put that shit on my lips, and I couldn't play for a week! Hee-heh-hee-heh... It was good for him, though, but it didn't work for me no kind of way.
